title: Unchecked Exception Cascades (Open-Closed Principle Violation)
pattern: Declaring low-level exceptions in the signatures of high-level business functions.
why_bad: Breaking encapsulation. Modifying a low-level API forces signature changes and rebuilds of all intermediate layers up the stack.
detection: Exception propagation declarations referencing low-level implementation details in high-level domain functions.
counterexample: Closed application systems with only single layers or unified error categories.
fix: Wrap low-level errors in unified domain exceptions at boundary interfaces.
